name: Annual Sales Target – Validation & Band Assignment
script:
# Annual Sales Target – Validation & Band Assignment
# Frappe v15
# Runs on: VALIDATE
# IMPORTANT: Do NOT wrap in def validate()

# ------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prevent duplicate customers
# ------------------------------------------------
seen_customers = set()

for row in (doc.customers or []):
    if not row.customer:
        continue

    if row.customer in seen_customers:
        frappe.throw(
            f"Customer {row.customer} is entered more than once."
        )

    seen_customers.add(row.customer)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 2. Prepare bands (sorted by ceiling)
# ------------------------------------------------
bands = sorted(
    (doc.bands or []),
    key=lambda b: (b.ceiling_amount or 0)
)

if not bands:
    frappe.throw(
        "Please define at least one Band with a ceiling amount."
    )

# Reset band rollups
for band in bands:
    band.allocated_amount = 0
    band.customer_count = 0

# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. Assign bands to customers
# ------------------------------------------------
allocated_total = 0

for row in (doc.customers or []):
    if not row.customer:
        continue

    if not row.target_amount or row.target_amount <= 0:
        frappe.throw(
            f"Target amount must be greater than zero for customer {row.customer}."
        )

    assigned_band = None

    for band in bands:
        if row.target_amount <= band.ceiling_amount:
            assigned_band = band
            break

    if not assigned_band:
        frappe.throw(
            f"No suitable band found for customer {row.customer} "
            f"with target {row.target_amount}. "
            f"Please add a higher ceiling band."
        )

    # Assign band info to customer row
    row.band_name = assigned_band.band_name
    row.band_ceiling_amount = assigned_band.ceiling_amount

    # Update band rollups (NO += in server scripts)
    assigned_band.allocated_amount = (
        assigned_band.allocated_amount or 0
    ) + row.target_amount

    assigned_band.customer_count = (
        assigned_band.customer_count or 0
    ) + 1

    allocated_total = allocated_total + row.target_amount

# ------------------------------------------------
# 4. Annual rollups
# ------------------------------------------------
doc.allocated_target_amount = allocated_total
doc.shortfall_amount = (doc.annual_target_amount or 0) - allocated_total

# ------------------------------------------------
# 5. Coverage % calculation (FINAL FIX)
# ------------------------------------------------
if doc.annual_target_amount and doc.annual_target_amount > 0:
    doc.coverage_pct = (allocated_total / doc.annual_target_amount) * 100
else:
    doc.coverage_pct = 0

name: Annual Sales Target – Active Version Enforcement
script:
# Annual Sales Target – Active Version Enforcement
# Frappe v15 – FINAL, RELIABLE VERSION
# Runs on: BEFORE SUBMIT

# ---------------------------------------------
# 1. Deactivate other active targets (same FY + Company)
# ---------------------------------------------
other_targets = frappe.get_all(
    "Annual Sales Target",
    filters={
        "company": doc.company,
        "fiscal_year": doc.fiscal_year,
        "is_active": 1,
        "name": ["!=", doc.name]
    },
    pluck="name"
)

for name in other_targets:
    frappe.db.set_value(
        "Annual Sales Target",
        name,
        "is_active",
        0
    )

# ---------------------------------------------
# 2. Determine correct version number
# ---------------------------------------------
if doc.amended_from:
    previous_version = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Annual Sales Target",
        doc.amended_from,
        "version"
    ) or 0
    new_version = previous_version + 1
else:
    new_version = 1

# ---------------------------------------------
# 3. Persist version & active flag (CRITICAL)
# ---------------------------------------------
frappe.db.set_value(
    "Annual Sales Target",
    doc.name,
    {
        "version": new_version,
        "is_active": 1
    }
)

name: Annual Sales Target – Build Revision History
script:
# Annual Sales Target – Build Revision History
# Frappe v15 compatible
# Builds revision history by walking amended_from chain

history_lines = []
current = doc

while current:
    # Get revision reason (if any)
    reason = current.revision_reason or "Initial submission"

    history_lines.append(
        f"{current.name}\n• {reason}"
    )

    if current.amended_from:
        current = frappe.get_doc("Annual Sales Target", current.amended_from)
    else:
        break

# Reverse so oldest is first
history_lines.reverse()

doc.revision_history = "\n\n".join(history_lines)

name: Annual Sales Target – Period Integrity
script:
# Annual Sales Target – Period Integrity
# Frappe v15
# Runs on: VALIDATE
# IMPORTANT: No `return` statements allowed in Server Scripts

# ------------------------------------------------
# Only proceed when both fields are selected
# ------------------------------------------------
if doc.period_start_fy and doc.period_end_fy:

    start_fy = frappe.get_doc("Fiscal Year", doc.period_start_fy)
    end_fy = frappe.get_doc("Fiscal Year", doc.period_end_fy)

    # ------------------------------------------------
    # Logical validation
    # ------------------------------------------------
    if start_fy.year_start_date > end_fy.year_end_date:
        frappe.throw("Period End FY cannot be before Period Start FY.")

    # ------------------------------------------------
    # Derive period dates
    # ------------------------------------------------
    doc.period_start_date = start_fy.year_start_date
    doc.period_end_date = end_fy.year_end_date

    # ------------------------------------------------
    # Derive Period Type & Label
    # ------------------------------------------------
    if doc.period_start_fy == doc.period_end_fy:
        doc.period_type = "Single Year"
        doc.period_label = f"FY {doc.period_start_fy}"
    else:
        doc.period_type = "Multi Year"
        doc.period_label = f"FY {doc.period_start_fy} to {doc.period_end_fy}"

Dn to Shipment
script:
# =========================================================
# SET SHIPMENT WAY
# =========================================================

frappe.db.set_value(
    "Shipment",
    doc.name,
    "custom_shipment_way",
    "Outgoing"
)

# =========================================================
# CLEAR EXISTING CHILD TABLES
# =========================================================

frappe.db.delete("Shipment Box", {
    "parent": doc.name
})

frappe.db.delete("Shipment Outer Box", {
    "parent": doc.name
})

inner_box_index = 1
processed_delivery_notes = []

# =========================================================
# CREATE SHIPMENT BOXES
# =========================================================

for dn_row in doc.shipment_delivery_note:

    if not dn_row.delivery_note:
        continue

    # Avoid duplicate DN
    if dn_row.delivery_note in processed_delivery_notes:
        continue

    processed_delivery_notes.append(
        dn_row.delivery_note
    )

    dn = frappe.get_doc(
        "Delivery Note",
        dn_row.delivery_note
    )

    for item in dn.items:

        qty = frappe.utils.flt(item.qty)

        if qty <= 0:
            continue

        child = frappe.get_doc({

            "doctype": "Shipment Box",

            "parent": doc.name,

            "parenttype": "Shipment",

            "parentfield": "custom_shipment_box",

            "inner_box_no": f"D-{inner_box_index}",

            "delivery_note": dn.name,

            "item_code": item.item_code,

            "item_name": item.item_name,

            "item_description":
                item.description or item.item_name,

            "qty": qty,

            "uom": item.uom,

            "gross_weight": 0,

            "net_weight": 0,

            "packed": 0,

            "outer_box": ""

        })

        child.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

        inner_box_index += 1

# =========================================================
# RELOAD DOCUMENT
# =========================================================

frappe.db.commit()

name: Shipment Fix
script:
delivery_note = frappe.form_dict.get("delivery_note")

if not delivery_note:
    frappe.throw("Delivery Note is required")

dn = frappe.get_doc("Delivery Note", delivery_note)

items = []

for d in dn.items:

    shipment_boxes = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sb.qty),0) as used_qty
        FROM `tabShipment Box` sb
        INNER JOIN `tabShipment` s ON s.name = sb.parent
        WHERE
            sb.delivery_note = %s
            AND sb.item_code = %s
            AND s.docstatus = 1
    """, (delivery_note, d.item_code), as_dict=True)

    used_qty = shipment_boxes[0].used_qty if shipment_boxes else 0

    remaining_qty = (d.qty or 0) - used_qty

    if remaining_qty <= 0:
        continue

    items.append({
        "delivery_note": delivery_note,
        "item_code": d.item_code,
        "item_name": d.item_name,
        "description": d.description,
        "qty": remaining_qty,
        "uom": d.uom,
        "rate": d.rate,
        "used_qty": used_qty
    })

if not items:
    frappe.throw("All items from this Delivery Note are already fully linked to Shipments")

frappe.response["message"] = items
